versions.changelog: Security: --format no longer overrides the audio-extension check, which was the only thing deciding whether a local file could be uploaded; naming a codec allowed any file to be sent to object storage and the transcription service. --format is now restricted to the known formats and only labels the codec.
Security: move console URLs off the credential-noun line that a secret scanner was matching; pin requests in requirements.txt so the installed dependency set cannot diverge from the reviewed one
Security: stop packaging internal development notes (added .clawhubignore); the published artifact no longer contains a note directing agents to modify the skill repository
Add negative trigger conditions, Troubleshooting section, allowed-tools field. Sync TOS_REGION as Required.

- Added explicit notice in the description that this skill is for recorded audio transcription only and should NOT be used for real-time/streaming speech recognition, TTS, or live captioning.
- Declared allowed Bash tool (python3) via the new allowed-tools field.
- No functional or API usage changes; informational and metadata adjustments only.

- Removed dependency on the Volcengine TOS Python SDK (`tos`) — now only requires the `requests` library.
- Updated documentation to reflect the removal of `tos` from dependencies in both install instructions and metadata. 
- No change to API usage, input/output, or environment variables.

Version 0.5.0

- Switched audio upload to official Volcengine TOS SDK (`tos` Python package) for more secure, reliable uploads within Volcengine infrastructure.
- Updated SKILL.md with clearer step-by-step TOS bucket setup instructions, region selection guidance, and credential requirements.
- Expanded documentation to include a full environment variable summary and detailed setup instructions in both English and Chinese.
- Added the `tos` package to required dependencies in the metadata.

- Switched authentication to use VOLCENGINE_API_KEY (previously VOLCENGINE_APP_ID and VOLCENGINE_ACCESS_TOKEN).
- Updated environment variable names for credential setup.
- Improved and clarified documentation in SKILL.md, including credential instructions and Chinese translation.
- Updated dependency and requirements metadata.
- General polish and clearer references to official model names.
